profile.headline: Data Pipelines @ GitHub
profile.summary:
Distributed systems engineer scaling infrastructure with 99.999% reliability. See my talks at the LinkedIn Engineering Stream Processing Meetups:
- Kafka at GitHub; managing clusters and usage - https://youtu.be/rYhZqgJNlnU?&t=265
- Do Virtual Threads improve KafkaConsumer throughput? - https://youtu.be/jaLTCgFQL0E?&t=2139

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Data Pipelines; I manage GitHub’s Tier 0 messaging platform built on self-managed Kafka clusters ingesting over 14 million messages per second and a job queue service serving over 24 billion background jobs per day.
